modmenu.descriptionTranslation.ssc-prima: The official addon of Shape Shifter Curse: adds gameplay centered on instinct control for feral forms. As your Primalstinct progresses, you will be granted greater power.. at only a tiny, negligible cost. Will you answer the call of the Primalstinct?

Primal Call chance per mob kill
item.ssc-primalstinct.primal_instinct_fa: It has no effect. The Primalstinct rejects your current form.
power.ssc-primalstinct.bed_spawn_only.de: Beds only set your spawn point; you cannot sleep in them.
power.ssc-primalstinct.prevent_villager_: Villagers refuse to trade with you.
ssc-primalstinct.selection.title: Choose Your Form
ssc-primalstinct.form.shape-shifter-curs: A pack leader that summons hosts of wolf spirits to fight, turning withering decay into its own strength.
A magical creature altered by outside magic, keeping company with witches and illagers, feeding on the energy of other beings.
A hunter that feeds on raw meat, climbs with ease, and hunts with sweeping claws - but burns through its hunger quickly.
A predator that draws on cold magic, attacks with leaps and empowered snowballs, and springs swiftly across the land - but fears fire greatly.
hud.ssc-primalstinct.level_down: You sense the Primalstinct within you shrink back; your thoughts grow a little clearer.
hud.ssc-primalstinct.level_up: The Primalstinct within you grows stronger.
hud.ssc-primalstinct.level_up.1: The Primalstinct awakens in your blood. You can feel it gradually growing stronger... This will have consequences.
hud.ssc-primalstinct.level_up.2: As the Primalstinct strengthens, you feel more at home in this body. Perhaps that is not a bad thing...
hud.ssc-primalstinct.level_up.3: You have grown stronger. Your body occasionally refuses to obey, and reading has become a little harder - but it is nothing you cannot handle... right?
hud.ssc-primalstinct.level_up.4: You can barely tell the Primalstinct apart from your own will anymore. You had better do something about it... unless you wish to become a beast entirely.
hud.ssc-primalstinct.level_up.locked: Hunt... Forage... Survive... A beast needs no extra thoughts.
ssc-primalstinct.level_up.4.dialog: Almost there... cast off... the last...
chat.ssc-primalstinct.primal_call.starte: A primal call echoes within your heart... Before it fully awakens, there may still be a chance to dispel its effect.
chat.ssc-primalstinct.remnant.range_exha: The nearby answers have all gone silent. Explore farther away.
chat.ssc-primalstinct.threshold_approach: Your instinct is about to reach its next stage...
message.ssc-primalstinct.bed_uncomfortab:
You try to sleep in the bed, but the feel of the fabric is unbearable.
Curling up on the ground would be far more comfortable.
message.ssc-primalstinct.drop_certain: Unable to stand the feel of wielding a tool, you fling it aside in disgust.
message.ssc-primalstinct.drop_random: You blank out for a moment - the tool slips from your grasp unnoticed.
message.ssc-primalstinct.interaction_cer: You rack your memory, but cannot recall how to use this thing...
message.ssc-primalstinct.interaction_ran: You suddenly forget what this thing is even for... strange.
message.ssc-primalstinct.villager_refuse: The villager looks at you in confusion, unable to grasp what your cries mean.
ssc-primalstinct.sleep.need_ground: You must be on the ground to curl up.
ssc-primalstinct.sleep.no_vehicle: Cannot curl up in a vehicle.
ssc-primalstinct.sleep.unavailable: You can only curl up to sleep at night.
It has no effect on you.
The Primalstinct within you fades away; at last, your mind feels clear again.

ssc-primalstinct.endgame.altar.claimed:
Very good...
Choose...
Use it now... to still... the instinct... and stay mundane...
Or cast it into... the frame... for an audience... and metamorphosis...
ssc-primalstinct.endgame.altar.not_eligi: It does not respond to your touch.
ssc-primalstinct.endgame.dialog.conversi: The air grows thick and warm; instinct surges with every heartbeat. The silhouette ahead sharpens: a silent dais, ringed by shadow.
The ground begins to resonate. Something ancient has noticed you - it waits somewhere ahead for a hunter whose instinct has burned to its very edge.
It stands before you. A vast shade looms over the dais, countless gazes piercing your fur. Step onto the platform, crouch low - the final metamorphosis awaits your consent.

The chill of the dais seeps through your pads. You hear it - not a sound, but a whisper rising from the depths of instinct itself:
"Crouch. Give yourself back to the Primal."
ssc-primalstinct.endgame.info.primal_oce:
Awaken, my kin.

A beast's mind is of no use to me. You have been lent a measure of control over the Primalstinct.
Go back, and fulfill your purpose:
hunt, and spread my will.

ssc-primalstinct.endgame.portal.fell: The edge of the void pushes you back to the sanctum.
